name: Will-o'-Wisp
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Damage Resistances
traits.description: Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.

traits.name: Consume Life
traits.description: As a bonus action, the will-o'-wisp can target one creature it can see within 5 ft. of it that has 0 hit points and is still alive. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw against this magic or die. If the target dies, the will-o'-wisp regains 10 (3d6) hit points. (Descriptive only: no bonus-action kill of a creature at 0 hit points and no 3d6 heal. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

traits.name: Ephemeral
traits.description: The will-o'-wisp can't wear or carry anything.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The will-o'-wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. (Descriptive only: no pass-through and no end-of-turn force damage. No ethereal form. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

traits.name: Variable Illumination
traits.description: The will-o'-wisp sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of ft. equal to the chosen radius. The will-o'-wisp can alter the radius as a bonus action. (Descriptive only: the radius is chosen, so this is not emits_light. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

actions.name: Shock

attack_bonus.reason: SRD 5.1 Will-o'-Wisp Shock prints +4; Dex 28 + PB 2 = +11

actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The will-o'-wisp and its light magically become invisible until it attacks or uses its Consume Life, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). (Descriptive only: no invisibility action construct. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)
